title: GenerateChangeSummary.v1
description: Request to generate (once, single-flight) the summaries of a version pair for the given locales. Crosses from the cell to the global region, so by contract it carries no engagement, firm or user data (RF-056, INV-06).
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.4 catalog CMD-01; RF-045, RF-050; US-05.1.3. Producer: ms-engagement-index, ms-experience-gateway. Consumers: ms-change-summary. Channel: cell EventBridge bus -> global EventBridge bus (only cell->global flow) -> rule -> SQS global-ms-change-summary-commands. Ordering/partition key: summaryKey (templateId, from, to). Idempotency key: summaryKey (single-flight). Guarantee: at-least-once. Versioning: additive within v1 (DISENO 4.2). dataClass: TEMPLATE_PUBLIC (DISENO 4.4). Crosses regions (whitelisted in the EventBridge rules); must not contain engagementId, firmId, userId or free text (contract test, DISENO 4.1). Response event(s): ChangeSummaryReady.v1, ChangeSummaryFailed.v1.
x-channel: cell EventBridge bus -> global EventBridge bus (only cell->global flow) -> rule -> SQS global-ms-change-summary-commands

from.description: Source version label (the engagement's real base).

locales.description: Locales to generate (minItems 1: an empty request is never sent).
